dependencies.upstream_data_sources_hint: index=k8s_metrics sourcetype=prometheus:scrape:metrics (or otel-prometheus-equivalent) from Splunk OpenTelemetry Collector for Kubernetes prometheus receiver jobs scraping kube-apiserver, etcd, kube-scheduler, and kube-controller-manager /metrics endpoints with labels preserved (job, instance, namespace, pod, k8s_cluster_name or cloud-specific cluster tags); index=k8s_audit sourcetype=kube:apiserver:audit for RequestResponse-level audit events on cluster-scoped update, delete, and patch verbs as a corroborating narrative plane; index=k8s_logs for optional static pod and systemd wrapper logs on self-managed control-plane nodes. Governance lookup cluster_platform_routing.csv with columns cluster, cloud, on_call_team, suppress_single_node_dev for paging and suppression metadata. candidates.title: CDN Origin Hit Rate and Cache Efficiency (CloudFront / Akamai / Fastly)

dependencies.upstream_data_sources_hint: AWS CloudFront access logs (`sourcetype=aws:cloudfront:accesslogs`), Akamai DataStream (`sourcetype=akamai:datastream`), and Fastly Real-Time Log Streaming (`sourcetype=fastly:cdn`). Each stream carries the cache-decision metadata that distinguishes HIT vs MISS vs ERROR at the edge: `x_edge_result_type` for CloudFront, `cacheStatus` for Akamai DataStream, and `cache_status` for Fastly. Hit ratio at edge is the single best indicator of CDN configuration health.
dependencies.upstream_app_hint: Splunk Add-on for AWS (`Splunk_TA_aws`, Splunkbase 1876) for CloudFront; Akamai DataStream syslog (raw forwarder, no Splunkbase TA); Fastly Real-Time Log Streaming via HEC (no Splunkbase TA, configured directly in Fastly UI)

Uses HTTP Server tests from Cloud Agents (globally distributed) targeting CDN-delivered URLs. Metrics: `http.client.request.duration` (seconds, TTFB), `http.server.throughput` (bytes/second), `http.server.request.availability` (percentage).
